name: JAL 602 老太太摔倒骨折 担架

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Japan Air 602, a flight from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters, make initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Japan Air 602，从东京飞往武汉，现在飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米。

cards.audioText: B: You now have an indication of a thunderstorm on your radar screen, fifty kilometers ahead of you, request ATC clearance to offset 5 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在雷达屏幕显示前方 50 公里有雷暴，请求 ATC 许可向右偏航 5 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, we have an indication of a thunderstorm 50 km ahead, request offset 5 miles to the right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，我们显示前方 50 公里有雷暴，请求向右偏航 5 海里。

cards.audioText: C: Japan Air 602, offset 5 miles to the right approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Japan Air 602，同意向右偏航 5 海里。
cards.referenceText: Offset 5 miles to the right approved, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 5 海里，JAL602。

cards.audioText: B: Later you find more thunderstorms ahead of you, request climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：随后你发现前方有更多雷暴，请求爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request climb to 10700 meters due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，因天气请求爬升至 10700 米。

cards.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, 10700 meters not available due to military activity at the moment, can you accept 11300 meters ?
B: Tell the controller you are unable to climb to 11300 meters due performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，目前因军事活动，10700 米不可用，可以接受 11300 米吗？
B：告诉管制员因性能原因无法爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, negative/unable due performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，不能接受，因性能原因无法爬升。

cards.audioText: B: To avoid thunderstorm, you request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for fifty miles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：为避让雷暴，你请求右转航向 240，并保持该航向 50 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for 50 miles to avoid thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，为避让雷暴，请求右转航向 240 并保持该航向 50 海里。

cards.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, negative, heading 240 is not available to restricted area, deviation to the left is available, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to turn left heading 080.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，不可以，航向 240 因限制区不可用，左侧偏航可用，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员你想左转航向 080。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, roger, request turn left heading 080.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，收到，请求左转航向 080。

cards.audioText: C: Japan Air 602, turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Japan Air 602，同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告，JAL602。

cards.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, how many miles do you want to fly on this heading?
B: Tell the controller fifty miles is enough for you.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，你想沿该航向飞多少海里？
B：告诉管制员 50 海里足够。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of weather, inform Wuhan Control and request direct to Zulu Foxtrot and descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，通知武汉管制，并请求直飞 Zulu Foxtrot 和下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, clear of weather, request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，已脱离天气，请求直飞 ZF 并下降。

cards.audioText: C: Japan Air 602, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, descend and maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Japan Air 602，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降并保持 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，JAL602。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see CBs in front of you, you want to maneuver 2 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在看到前方有 CB，想向右机动 2 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request maneuver 2 miles to the right due to CBs ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL602，前方有 CB，请求向右机动 2 海里。

cards.audioText: B: During maneuver, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and ask for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机动过程中，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，向武汉进近报告情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL602, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL602，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: Japan Air 602, roger, you are number 1, expect radar vectors, do you require any medical assistance on arrival ?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance, and you will open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Japan Air 602，收到，你是第一架，预计雷达引导，落地后需要医疗协助吗？
B：告诉管制员需要医疗协助，并将打开后客舱门，用担架让病患下机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL602, request medical assistance and open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL602，请求医疗协助，并打开后客舱门，用担架让病患下机。
